candidates.description: This feature activates on words and terms related to cinema, movies, and filmmaking across multiple languages.
This vector represents the concept of creation, generation, and related inflectional or cross-lingual roots associated with making something.
This vector activates on common European non-English stop words across Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector represents common German auxiliary, modal, and copula verbs in various inflected forms.
This feature activates on intensifiers and adverbs of degree that modify adjectives or verbs.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to understanding, finding, or knowing verbs across multiple Romance and Germanic languages.
These tokens represent conjugated verb forms and auxiliary verbs in Romance languages, primarily Spanish and Italian.
This vector represents first- and second-person personal pronouns across multiple languages.
This feature activates on words and subwords expressing strong astonishment, wonder, or remarkable visual and emotional impact.
This feature vector represents structured arrangements, patterns, or sequences of elements within a medium or system.
